Priya (CS): quick harvest from today's onboarding calls — 3 repeats that sound product-y and we should triage before next week's sync
Liam (PM): ok send the raw quotes + which accounts are at renewal risk?
Priya (CS): short list: 1) per-route cost breakdown missing -> customers overprovisioning GPUs (ACME, Brightlane) 2) embeddings drift / freshness controls (Nimbus) 3) need a self-serve 'pin model version' in console; blockers for internal platform teams (Seabreeze)
Marta (Product Ops): for prioritization can we score by (renewal_risk, dev_effort, frequency)?
Sam (CS): +1. renewal_risk for ACME & Seabreeze is high. I can surface usage graphs. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): pasting two raw lines from notes: "we're paying for tokens that aren't ours because we can't split by route" — ACME. "embeddings stop matching after 36h, our retrain cadence is manual" — Nimbus
Liam (PM): this feels like 2 quick wins (per-route cost exposure, model pin) and 1 longer infra piece (automated embedding refresh). proposal: quick fix = UI exposure + docs, medium = enable per-route billing flag, long = managed embedding refresh pipeline
Marta (Product Ops): agree. quick rubric I used before — copying here:
```
score = renewal_risk*3 + frequency*2 - dev_effort
threshold_quick = 8
```
Priya (CS): Sam can you run that rubric on the 12 captured asks and post top 3? I'll add screenshots and direct quotes to each ticket.
Sam (CS): on it, will post results by EOD. tagging @Liam for scope when I finish the top 3.
CS-bot: Reminder: please attach each customer quote to a ticket in JIRA - label cs:customer-quote.
Liam (PM): once Sam posts the top 3 I can draft 2-pagers for each and pick which one to schedule for the next sprint planning.
Priya (CS): thanks — goal: have decision for at least one quick win (UI exposure + doc) at next product sync. :raised_hands:
